One of the impactful initiatives made possible through this funding is the construction of a new emergency homeless shelter for @FSABucksCo, with comprehensive on-site services, including mental health and substance use treatment, Housing-First case management, nursing care, and wellness programming.
 
Since 1954, FSABC has been a cornerstone of our community, changing lives and providing hope for individuals and families. With the $2.9 Million I secured for this incredible project, FSABC will be able to double its shelter capacity, break down the barriers of waitlists, and ensure that no one is turned away from the critical support needed to rebuild their lives. Thank you to Julie Dees and the entire FSABC team for your unwavering dedication to our community. I'm proud to support you and look forward to continuing to work alongside you in our shared mission to strengthen our community.
